|quest_reward4_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Rain of Arrows''' is a ranged [[attack]] [[skill]] that fires a number of arrows in the air, which deal [[area of effect]] [[projectile]] damage as they land. Arrows initially fall at the targeted location, then spread outward. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Arrow placement:''' Half of the arrows fall randomly within the skill's area of effect. The other half picks targets in a series of rings ''around'' the targeted location.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2133090 * '''AoE''': Each arrow deals area damage where it lands. A single enemy can be hit multiple times, though the likelihood of this depends on the skill's area of effect modifiers and enemy size. Against an average-sized boss, 2-5 hits per attack is a realistic expectation. * '''Additional Arrows/Projectiles:''' Additional arrows will be added at the outer portion of the area of effect, increasing its coverage, but not damage to individual targets. Support gems such as {{il|Greater Multiple Projectiles Support}} are likely unattractive, as their projectile count is additive with the large arrow count this skill has by default. * '''Attack speed''': The skill's [[attack speed]] affects both the user's attack animation and how fast arrows strike the ground. * '''Travel distance''': Effects like {{psl|Point Blank}} use the distance between where the skill was used and the enemy that was hit. * '''[[Projectile#Projectile_Behaviours|Projectile behaviours]]''': Projectiles from Rain of Arrows do not collide with enemies or terrain; they cannot use mechanics like [[Pierce]] or [[Return]]. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = # Arrows |c1_header = Fires x Arrows |c1_pattern_extract = Fires (%d+) Arrows |c1_pattern_value = %d }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Related unique items== These [[unique item]]s have some interaction with Rain of Arrows {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Rain%of%Arrows%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Now has a Mana cost of 6 at gem level 1 (previously 7), scaling up to 10 at gem level 20 (previously 11). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now causes the skill to Fires +0-4 Arrows, instead of providing 0-10% increased Area of Effect. }} {{Version history table row|3.9.0| * Now deals 48% of base damage at gem level 1 (from 40%), up to 60% at gem level 20 (from 50%). }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * Now includes the "Projectile" tag on the skill gem. }} {{Version history table row|3.3.0| * Now fires a number of arrows across the area, dealing damage based on weapon damage with each one. Half of these arrows will target enemies in the area, while the rest will target the area at set ranges from the centre at random. * Now has an added damage effectiveness and base damage of 40% at gem level 1 (down from 110%), up to 50% at gem level 20 (down from 129%). }} {{Version history table row|2.6.0| * Rain of Arrows gains 1 additional unit of radius every 5 levels. * No longer gain increased area of effect radius. }} {{Version history table row|2.3.0| * If you use Rain of Arrows, {{il|Blast Rain}} and {{il|Bladefall}} to target a blocked location then they will be now used on the nearest valid location. }} {{Version history table row|2.1.0| * Rain of Arrows has had its base damage increased by a flat 10% at every level.
